This is a remote position.

Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)
My VA Support is seeking a Virtual Interior Designer with a high level of English proficiency (B2+) for a full-time position requiring 45 hours per week.
As an Interior Designer, you'll create functional, safe, and aesthetically pleasing spaces by assessing space requirements, determining optimal furniture placement, and selecting decorative items, adhering to relevant blueprint, building code, and inspection requirements.
Daily tasks include assisting with various duties such as modifying SketchUp drawings, creating new drawings with AutoCAD, and occasionally editing photos, changing backgrounds, or modifying images in Photoshop.
Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with clients to understand initial goals and requirements for the space.
  • Work with architects, engineers, painters, and builders for comprehensive space understanding.
  • Analyze movement and use patterns of the space.
  • Prepare sketches or other visual aids to demonstrate preliminary designs to the client.
  • Consult with clients to select materials, furnishings, and décor.
  • Use design applications to prepare and illustrate final plans.
  • Determine project timelines and costs, presenting accurate estimates to clients.
  • Obtain necessary materials, adhering to project and budget specifications.
  • Oversee the installation of materials, furniture, and other design elements.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by resolving any complaints or concerns.
  • Maintain current knowledge of trends, materials, techniques, and other developments in interior design.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, AutoCAD, Reddit, SketchUp, and MS Office Suite.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong sense of style and ability to create aesthetically pleasing interiors.
  • Proficient visual design skills, including proportion and aesthetics.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to use computer-aided design (CAD) software.
  • Basic understanding of building codes and inspection regulations related to interiors.
Education and Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or a related field.
  • Coursework in computer-aided design (CAD) highly preferred.
  • Interior design certification highly preferred.
  • At least one year of related experience required.

Benefits

  • 100% work from home
  • Structured work schedule
  • Payment commensurate with experience and expectations
We look forward to receiving your application!

We are looking for an ambitious and highly creative Lead Interior Designer to lead the design and delivery of high-end residential and hospitality projects.

The successful candidate will have a proven record of completed projects and will be able to demonstrate their personal contribution from concept through construction and handover. They will lead and develop the interior design team, set a strong creative direction, and create and implement design standards across projects.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong design judgement, ownership and resilience. The candidate must be able to manage tasks, teams and timelines across multiple projects, including work with short deadlines, while protecting quality and raising risks early.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead interior design projects from concept through handover.
  • Create and implement design standards across projects.
  • Manage, develop and coordinate the interior design team.
  • Set priorities, allocate tasks and track team timelines.
  • Review design proposals, drawings, materials, FF&E and visualisations.
  • Coordinate with project teams, consultants, contractors and suppliers.
  • Resolve design and delivery issues while protecting the design intent.
  • Present design proposals to clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate risks earlly

Requirements

  • Degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture or a related discipline.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience.
  • At least three years of team management experience.
  • Portfolio of completed high-end residential and hospitality projects.
  • Demonstrated involvement from concept through construction and handover.
  • Strong creativity, leadership and communication skills.
  • Basic project management ability and experience managing team tasks and timelines.
  • Resilience and proven ability to deliver under pressure and to short deadlines.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Benefits

  • Work on projects from concept to realization: contribute across the full architectural journey, from early vision and planning to execution and operational experience.
  • Design with long-term impact: create spaces intended to become globally recognized hospitality destinations.
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: work closely with interiors, landscape, construction, operations, and guest experience teams from the earliest stages.
  • Creative influence from the ground up: contribute ideas before projects are locked into rigid systems or external frameworks.
  • Global architectural exposure: work on location-specific projects influenced by diverse cultural, environmental, and hospitality contexts.
  • High design standards: join a team deeply focused on detail, materiality, atmosphere, and timeless hospitality design.
  • End-to-end development insight: gain exposure not only to design, but also to execution, operations, and the realities of luxury hospitality development.
  • Exposure to luxury standards and materials: work with elevated design references, premium finishes, and globally inspired concepts.
  • Influence guest experience through design: contribute to how spaces function emotionally as well as aesthetically.

This is a remote position.

Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)
We are in search of an experienced Architectural & Interior Designer who is fervent about design and possesses a rich background in both residential and commercial project designs, mainly in kitchens and bathrooms.
As a Kitchen/ Bathrooms Designer/Architect, you will be responsible for the conceptualization and execution of kitchen/bathrooms design projects from inception to completion. This role demands a high level of creativity, attention to detail, and technical proficiency.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and plan kitchen/bathroom renovations that meet client specifications and recent trends.
  • Create detailed construction documents for client presentations and supplier coordination.
  • Utilize design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Revit, 3DS Max, and Lumion to produce high-quality visualizations.
  • Engage with clients to refine designs and confirm requirements, ensuring satisfaction and adherence to timelines.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure a cohesive approach to project execution.
  • Creation and elevation of designs using the 20/20 platform.
  • Deployment of the KCDW software for developing and presenting precise kitchen concept visuals.
  • Execution of 3D modeling and elementary rendering for architectural and interior designs utilizing Revit and Sketchup.
  • Production of detailed planimetric sketches employing AutoCAD.
Contract Details:
  • Type: International Service Provision
  • In compliance with each Goverment regulations, the contractor will be held responsible for their own social security and tax payments.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Lumion, 3DS Max, and Revit; knowledge of 20/20 software is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of experience in kitchen design and renovation.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing previous kitchen projects.
  • Excellent understanding of construction documentation and experience with both U.S. and international metric systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with a keen attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team-oriented environment.
  • Manage and coordinate projects, including tasks related to audit, refurbishment, carpentry, management reporting, reconciliations, urban regeneration, and 3D modeling.
  • Utilize your skills in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop for visual presentations.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and industry standards in architectural design.

Benefits

Company Overview:Join a cutting-edge and forward-thinking design firm dedicated to crafting transformative residential and commercial spaces. Our emphasis on creativity, precision, and technical expertise sets us apart.
Why Join Us?Become an integral part of a dynamic, innovative team that appreciates and recognizes your architectural design proficiency. Your expertise will not only be valued but will also drive the company to new design frontiers.
Thank you for considering a role with us. We eagerly await your application!

If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply. This position may be filled anywhere in the United States.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This senior-level position is a leadership role within our multi-disciplinary team, responsible for guiding and mentoring project teams across multiple interior design projects. The Interior Designer V will demonstrate expertise in furniture planning, specification, procurement coordination, design leadership, storytelling, and strategic impact. This role requires proactive communication, independent conceptualization, and a commitment to quality and standards. The individual will serve as a furniture subject matter expert, collaborate with design leaders and contribute to business development and community engagement.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Provide leadership to the client and project team in establishment of the project goals and vision.
  • Operates with high autonomy and strategic influence, guiding firm-wide standards, mentoring teams, and setting design direction independently.
  • Provide interior design leadership across multiple projects with a focus on furniture planning, building a strong conceptual strategy for the project that is rooted in the client’s vision and aspirations.
  • Guides and motivates teams, leads the creative process, and promotes firm strategies, policies, and procedures.
  • Expected to conceptualize, set direction for design, with a focus on furniture planning, and oversee production and discipline coordination.
  • Lead the interior design approach of the project’s goals through all phases of the project (the Pursuit, Programming and Visioning, Concept Design, Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Design, Procurement and Construction Administration).
  • Evaluate client needs, analyze and effectively document design objectives and spatial requirements.
  • Coordinate and delegate project design work and code compliance.
  • Collaborate work with other disciplines, including architecture, engineering, strategy, experiential branding and consultants.
  • Conduct a review of drawings and support functions in conformance with project time, budget and quality constraints.
  • Delegation and oversight of and production of design visualization.
  • Collaborate with project leaders to develop project work plans for the interior design components of the project and monitor design staff adherence to schedule.
  • Lead client meetings and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Implement, follow, maintain, and enforce interior design standards used throughout interior design team in all project aspects/phases.
  • Lead the development of and/or oversee documentation for furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FFE) throughout all phases of the interior furniture design work, as required.
  • Lead the development of material palettes that communicate stories and support the client’s objectives
  • Specification oversight.
  • Mentor and guide less experienced interior design staff.
  • Actively participate and promote design excellence and firm strategies.
  • Collaborate with design leadership and participate in business development opportunities, and industry events
  • Consult with furniture manufacturers, dealers, product vendors and industry partners, building strong relationships in the design community.
  • Lead and/or participate in marketing activities, including proposal development and interviews.
  • Participate in construction administration activities, including site visits, review of submittals and shop drawings, and conducting punch lists. Site visits frequently require a physical walk-through of site.
  • Ensure sustainability metrics goals are met for projects.
  • Work within project budgets and schedules to meet profitability goals.
  • Maintain 80% billable time and 10% marketing time.
  • May perform other duties as required.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED
  • Bachelor or Master's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or relevant field required.
  • A minimum of 10 years of related experience is required.
  • Current NCIDQ certification or applicable certification/licensure preferred.
  • Ability to provide interior design leadership focusing on furniture across multiple projects.
  • Strong experiential design, storytelling and technical skills as well as the knowledge of building and life safety codes required.
  • Exceptional presentation, organizational, team building, collaboration and communication skills are a must.
  • The ability to build and maintain client relationships is essential.
  • Experience leading a high performing team and mentoring staff is required.
  • Conceptualization and ability to set direction for furniture planning, furniture palettes, specifications and implementation.
  • Application of standards and quality process adherence.
  • Production oversight and discipline coordination.
  • Critical thinker and highly analytical.
  • Must be a fully qualified professional able to perform work with a high degree of self-motivation, autonomy and strategic influence.
  • Proficiency with Revit, Enscape, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Suite required.
  • Travel as required.
The salary range for this position is $98,328 to $122,933 annually. This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at . Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.
ABOUT OUR FIRM
CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.
ABOUT WORKING HERE
  • We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.
  • We are committed to ensuring our practice provides equal opportunities for all employees, as we strive to connect with communities around us and focus on the future of design. We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.
  • We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.
Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.
As a condition of employment, all employees are expected to complete mandatory training, including compliance training, within required timeframes and adhere to our internal policies and our Code of Conduct.
CannonDesign is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CannonDesign is committed to maintaining a work environment that is free from any and all forms of unlawful discrimination and harassment. It is therefore the firm’s policy to prohibit discrimination and harassment against any applicant, CannonDesign employee, vendor, contractor, or client on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. From concept to completion the Interior Designer II is responsible for managing design components and client engagement across all project phases. The role requires both creativity, technical expertise, with a strong understanding of project workflows, documentation standards, and coordination. You will work in partnership to create and simultaneously deliver multiple, customized multi-family, hospitality, and well-centric projects.

Roles & Responsibilities
  • Support, design and coordinate all phases of the interior design process from concept development through installation.
  • Lead the production of schematic design, design development, and construction documents in trade software like Revit, AutoCAD, etc., with guidance and review from senior team members.
  • Support the selection and documentation of finishes, fixtures, furniture, and lighting with consideration for budget, availability, and performance.
  • Select and specify FFE products and accessories, developing custom furniture and drapery worksheets and updating furniture plans and documentation in AutoCAD and/or Revit.
  • Coordinate FFE development with the design team, including furniture plans, specifications, material selections, and FFE presentations aligned with the project vision and client brand.
  • Support preparation of documentation tied to design scope for proposals, change orders, and project milestone tracking.
  • Collaborate with the contracts and project managers to ensure design scope, budget, fees, and deliverables align with contract terms; support plan reviews and FFE takeoffs as needed.
  • Develop and review internal and client presentations for alignment with client vision, client branding packages, and CID conceptual design aesthetic.
  • Collaborate with clients, consultants, and vendors to coordinate and develop project-specific design features and materials embodying CID’s commitment to client experience and excellence in partnership.
  • Participate and occasionally lead in client presentations with clear communication of design intent and rationale.
  • Develop and review FF&E specifications, procurement documentation, and installation coordination.
  • Support FFE implementation through vendor coordination, installation scheduling, punch lists, returns, and on-site problem solving to ensure the design is carried through to completion.
  • Conduct and complete quality control reviews of drawing sets, sample boards, and specifications to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Support construction administration, including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals and shop drawings, and attending site visits as needed.
  • Monitor scope boundaries and proactively flag potential changes that may impact schedule, budget, or contract terms.
  • Partner with team lead and other departments to support standard processes and create team efficiency.
  • Provide clear project level guidance and accountability on design development and technical documentation.



Foster a culture that promotes CID’s Core Values
  • Forage | We embody a resourceful mindset, thoughtfully seeking inspiration, solutions, and opportunity while nurturing our connection to and appreciation for the natural world.
  • Action | We are a high-performing, purpose-driven team that takes initiative, follows through, and executes with excellence.

  • Curious | We maintain an open mindset and a constant pursuit of becoming our best, fueled by a genuine joy for learning and growth.
  • Team | We collaborate through trust and deep respect to accomplish our shared purpose. None of us are as strong as all of us.

Education + Experience Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in interior design or architecture from an accredited institution
  • WELL AP certification and other industry experience as needed
  • 6+ years of experience in a similar position. Preferably with multi-family, hospitality, spa, and/or commercial industries
  • Skills in Revit and AutoCAD with strong knowledge of Adobe Suite (especially Photoshop), MS Office (especially PowerPoint), Bluebeam, and SWW (a plus).
  • Working knowledge of modeling software (Sketch -up, 3D Studios, Rhino 3-D, etc.)
  • Strong space planning ability, knowledge of building codes, building systems, and construction methods.
  • Understanding of current design trends, materials costs, budgets and specifications.
  • Experience specifying FFE for a variety of project types ( i.e. models, clubhouses, pools, etc.,).
  • Ability to manage priorities with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through while fostering collaboration and communicating effectively through written, verbal, and visual channels.
